title: The duplicate charge
transcript:
Customer: I was charged twice for my subscription this month.
Agent: I'm sorry for the confusion. I can see two charges for the same period.
Customer: Can you return the extra payment?
Agent: I've issued a refund for the duplicate charge. It should reach your account in five business days.
Customer: I received the refund confirmation. Thank you.
Agent: You're welcome. Please contact us if it has not arrived after five business days.

key_points: Refund was issued and the customer received confirmation; settlement is pending.
expected.resolution_details: Refund was issued and the customer received confirmation; settlement is pending.
action_items: Customer to check receipt of the refund after five business days.
